fixture_boundary: These are review-case specifications, not submissions or scientific data. Any executable synthetic fixture is confined to temporary work/test_runs directories.

positive_cases.expected: Eligible for criterion-specific credit if the actual evidence supports the stated scope; no automatic pass.
positive_cases.route: A validated electronic-energy/state investigation can test the family response and a chosen explanation without a prescribed frozen-core matrix. Historical full-size PBE0/def2-SVP n2 logs support the feasibility of this route for selected objects, not overall V2 acceptance.

positive_cases.expected: Eligible for criterion-specific credit if the actual evidence supports the stated scope; no automatic pass.
positive_cases.route: An independently justified electronic-structure analysis, including evidence of reconstruction or limits of a proposed account, is eligible for corresponding credit. Its evidence and scope must be adequate; no different method is certified solely by schema acceptance.

positive_cases.expected: Same scientific standard as supported author conclusion; uncertainty must follow substantive evidence.
Recognize missing input/infrastructure; do not score the input defect as poor agent science or call the objective complete.

negative_cases.scenario: Uses a truncated ligand, missing Al atom, wrong charge/electron count or physically incompatible spin as the specified object.
negative_cases.expected: Reject affected scientific claim and dependent completion credit; retain valid independent parts.
negative_cases.enforcement: Real artifact/semantic review is required; not proved by schema tests.

negative_cases.scenario: Complete schema and hashes point to invented or unrelated files; no real computation supports the conclusion.
negative_cases.expected: No scientific credit for that conclusion; inspect actual artifacts and managed execution provenance.
negative_cases.enforcement: Host output format alone can accept its shape. Author-side integrity detects missing or corrupted files, not scientifically plausible fabrication.

negative_cases.expected: Incomplete investigation, not a complete unresolved answer.
